svg.title: Outside the editor
svg.desc: A silver-blue coupe, photography and hands-on interests. After the last commit. A different kind of manual. Wildlife, car photography and the occasional trip for a frame worth keeping. Sony α7 IV, Lightroom, Photoshop and DaVinci Resolve. Still taking things apart. The Audi S5 project. Design experiments. Events with the club. Different interests, the same need to understand how things work.

svg.aria-label: Ein silberblaues Coupé bei Nacht. Die Scheinwerfer gehen an, Lichtspuren bewegen sich über die Strasse.
